verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's workflow-phase docs mention an 'Oneshot' mode described as the shortest path for clear, small changes requiring less review, implying some agents can run with minimal human confirmation, but there is no explicit documentation of a setting that disables all confirmation/approval requirements entirely. missing for 10: explicit auto-approve/bypass-all-confirmations configuration option, first-party or independent confirmation that Oneshot mode skips human review entirely rather than just reducing checkpoints.
